title: Senior Engineer – ELV, ICT & Security
description:
**Got a flair for the complex? We’re hunting for a Senior Engineer – ELV, ICT \& Security with an understanding of risk mitigation planning and technical troubleshooting to join our outstanding Mumbai based team.**
**Here at Buro Happold, expect the exceptional.**
 From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career\-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.
   

  

**Your next role**
* Design and engineering of Building Management System (BMS) which includes controlling and monitoring of Building’s ELV equipment such as Ventilation \& Air conditioning systems, power systems, fire systems and access control systems
* Design and engineering of ICT/Telecommunication systems including Active and passive network, campus backbone cabling, Structured Cabling Infrastructure, IP Telephony, Wireless Data network etc
* Develop System Architecture for Telecom/Security/ELV Networks including selection of network switches, routers.
* Work with OEMs and vendors to finalize system configurations
* Preparation of Design basis report
* Preparation of Network Architecture for BMS \& ELV System
* Preparation of Input/Output points schedule \& control logic diagrams
* Design and calculations of Cable containments and conduits connecting various areas.
* Hands\-on experience of Indian and International codes for the design (NFPA, IS, NBC, BS, IEEE \& TIA.)
* Preparation \& Coordinate with designer to create System Architecture for ELV systems
* ELV system Layout coordination with other disciplines
* Having knowledge of Modelling, Drafting, and coordination using latest BIM software like Revit, AutoCAD, BIM360\.
* Attend coordination \& review meetings
* Preparation of Tender documents with relevant design, technical specifications, Equipment schedules, and BOQ as per requirement.
* Preparation of Technical bid analysis
* Review of technical data sheets and shop drawings submitted by various vendors/contractors
* Review and approval of Vendor document and drawing review including shop drawings
* Evaluate and advise on ICT, Security and ELV related design changes and non\-conformations to ensure fulfilment of the requirements


 Design integrated ELV and ICT infrastructure solutions which include
   

  

* BMS (Building management system)
* Fire Alarm system
* Video Surveillance (CCTV \& Video Analytics)
* Access Control Systems
* Public Address / IP Audio Systems
* Command \& Control Centres
* Network Infrastructure


**Your Skills And Experience**
* You will have been working in a design role with experience of designing security systems in the built environment for 8\-10 years.
* ELV \& ICT system design
* Security or surveillance systems engineering
* You will understand the design process and approach to designing security systems (VSS, AACS, IDS, PIDS, SMS), specifically being able to identify critical considerations and factors in design.
* Worked in Autodesk tools such as AutoCAD, Navisworks and Revit
* Authored technical security specifications on projects
* You will have a good knowledge of standards applicable to security and related systems.
* You will be able to clearly communicate concepts of security design and the rational which form the basis of a design.
* Ideally – a knowledge of basic coding (C\#), which can be applied to the development of design tools to facilitate automation.
* Typically engineers we recruit have studied security or technology related degrees, such as the following (though similar courses will be considered):
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronic Engineering
* Systems and Communications Engineering


**What We Offer You**
 Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package including Annual Discretionary Bonus, Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme for both you and your family, Group Personal Accident Cover
* Our 5\-day workweek policy supports work\-life balance, ensuring you have time to relax and recharge.
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Receive entitlements to two professional memberships or subscriptions, fostering your professional network and knowledge
* Benefit from our Employee Referral Bonus, rewarding you for bringing talented candidates into our fold
* A commitment to your wellbeing through a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellness initiatives designed to support your mental and physical health
* Back to Work Program for Women \- Swam Siddha \- We're committed to empowering women, facilitating seamless re\-entry into the workforce through our dedicated program
* Engage with our vibrant community through the Young Employees Forum, Diversity and Inclusion Forum, and BH Women's Network, fostering a supportive and diverse workplace culture
* Make a difference in the world with our Share Our Skills (SOS) program, offering opportunities to support local communities and those in need globally.
* An International Culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.


**Join us to find out what you’re capable of.**
**A place for everyone**
 Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
   

  

 Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
   

  

 We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
   

  

 Please let us know if there are any adjustments, we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact IndiaRecruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

title: Infrastructure Pentester – Active Directory / Internal Network
description:
**Pentester / Red Teamer** 

  
 




  





**Company:** 
 Redfox Cybersecurity
 
  
 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (On\-site)
 
  
 




  





**Experience Required:** 
 1–2 Years
 
  
 




  





**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 
  
 




  





**Joining:** 
 Immediate joiner preferred
 
  
 




  





**About Redfox Cybersecurity** 

  
 




  





 Redfox Cybersecurity is a leading global cybersecurity firm specializing in offensive security operations, threat intelligence, and advanced penetration testing services. With strategic offices in Mumbai (India), Toronto (Canada), Delaware (USA), and Abu Dhabi (Middle East), we serve Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and enterprises across North America, Middle East, Asia\-Pacific, and beyond.
 
  
 




  





 Our team of elite security professionals is dedicated to protecting organizations against evolving cyber threats through proactive security assessments and cutting\-edge offensive security methodologies.
 
  
 




  





 Our global presence enables us to deliver 24/7 security services and maintain deep expertise across diverse regulatory environments, industry sectors, and threat landscapes. As we continue to expand our operations in the Asia\-Pacific region, we are seeking talented individuals to join our Mumbai office and contribute to our mission of making the digital world safer.
 
  
 




  





**About the Role** 

  
 




  





 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **Pentester / Red Teamer** 
 to join our offensive security team at our Mumbai office. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on diverse, high\-impact projects for clients across multiple industries and geographies.
 
  
 




  





 The successful candidate will be part of a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovative approaches to security challenges.
 
  
 




  





 You will work alongside seasoned security professionals from our global offices, gain exposure to complex enterprise environments, and have the opportunity to contribute to real\-world security operations that make a tangible difference in our clients' security posture. This position provides exposure to international projects and the possibility of collaboration with our teams in Toronto, Delaware, and London.
 
  
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




  




* Conduct infrastructure penetration testing across internal and external networks, servers, network devices, and enterprise infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities and security weaknesses.
* Perform vulnerability discovery, exploitation, privilege escalation, and post\-exploitation activities across Windows and Linux\-based infrastructure, including network services and exposed systems.
* Execute red team operations simulating advanced persistent threats (APTs) and sophisticated attack scenarios.
* Perform security assessments of on\-premises and cloud\-based environments.
* Identify and exploit vulnerabilities within Active Directory environments, including privilege escalation and lateral movement techniques.
* Develop detailed technical reports documenting findings, risk assessments, and actionable remediation recommendations.
* Present findings and security recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
* Collaborate with blue team and security operations teams to improve defensive capabilities.
* Coordinate with global team members across different time zones on multi\-regional projects.
* Stay current with emerging threats, attack techniques, and security research.
* Contribute to the development of internal tools, methodologies, and testing frameworks.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing sessions and mentor junior team members, and create course content for Redfox Cybersecurity Academy.
* Support business development activities through technical demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept engagements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 




  




* 1–2 years of demonstrated hands\-on experience in application security, penetration testing, red teaming, and security reporting.
* Proficiency with industry\-standard penetration testing tools and frameworks (Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, BloodHound, etc.).
* Strong understanding of Active Directory security architecture, common misconfigurations, and exploitation techniques.
* In\-depth knowledge of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, MITRE ATT\&CK framework, and attack methodologies.
* Ability to develop and execute complex multi\-stage attack chains.
* Experience in vulnerability assessment, exploitation, and post\-exploitation techniques.
* Strong technical writing and documentation skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed global team.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Professional demeanor and ability to interact effectively with clients.



  





**Optional Qualifications (Good to Have)** 

  
 




  




* Knowledge of cloud security platforms and services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
* Experience with container security (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipeline security.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001, GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA).
* Published security research, technical blog posts, or conference presentations.
* Contributions to open\-source security tools or frameworks.
* Experience with scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ruby).
* Familiarity with wireless security, IoT security, or OT/ICS environments.
* Experience working in cross\-functional or international teams.



  






  
 
**What We Offer** 

  
 




  




* Opportunity to work with an internationally recognized cybersecurity team across four countries.
* Exposure to challenging and diverse security projects across multiple industries and geographies.
* Access to world\-class training programs, certifications, and professional development opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment that encourages innovation and knowledge sharing.
* Career progression opportunities within a rapidly growing global organization.
* Potential for international assignments and cross\-office collaborations.
* Professional certification sponsorship and continuous learning budget.



  





**How to Apply** 

  
 




  





 Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated curriculum vitae to hiring@redfoxsec.com with the subject line:
 
  
 




  





**"Application \- Pentester / Red Teamer \- Mumbai"** 

  
 




  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 

  
 




  





 Redfox Cybersecurity is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin

**Job Summary**
 Black \& Veatch is seeking an exceptional and experienced professional to join our Infrastructure Advisory organization as a Consultant – Consulting to provide expertise around OT SCADA Systems Engineering and Configuration. The world is changing at an unprecedented rate and that change increases the demand for innovation and efficiency to deliver solutions and services across the world’s utility infrastructure. Join Black \& Veatch’s growing Infrastructure Advisory business and use your talents and expertise to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our clients, with the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your professional network, and shape a rewarding career path aligned with your aspirations.
   

  

 The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early\-to\-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. Peers are engaged in a wide range of technical projects and encouraged to sharpen their skills to provide clients superior consulting services and continue to advance in a specialized career track. You will work with professionals in the Consulting and Digital Delivery Teams who represent a dynamic and cross\-functional group of experts in strategy, data, technology, and asset management systems. Together, they deliver innovative, data\-driven solutions that help clients navigate complex infrastructure challenges across diverse industries.
   

  

 We partner with clients to align their people, processes, technologies, and data in response to rapid industry transformation. Our work enables organizations to modernize infrastructure, optimize asset performance, enhance resilience, and achieve long\-term sustainability goals. By joining this team, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and client success. You’ll contribute to mission\-critical projects that make a meaningful impact on communities and industries around the world.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Configuration Engineer supports the implementation of operational technology systems such as ADMS and EMS by configuring system functionality based on defined requirements and design specifications. This role translates business and operational requirements into system configurations, supports testing activities, and assists with troubleshooting and go\-live readiness. The Configuration Engineer operates within the software delivery lifecycle and works closely with client vendors, solution architects, integrators, and testing teams to ensure accurate and effective system behavior.
   

  

**System Configuration \& Build**
* Configure OT applications (e.g., AMI HES, ADMS, EMS, SCADA components) in accordance with approved design documents and requirements.
* Experienced in AMI HES deployment and configuration, supporting smart meter integration, data communication, and remote operations within utility systems.
* Develop and maintain configuration workbooks and parameter sets to support system setup and deployment
* Ensure configuration aligns with business rules, operational workflows, and system constraints


**Requirements Translation \& Documentation**
* Analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into configuration specifications and workbooks
* Support design workshops and working sessions to clarify requirements and configuration approach
* Maintain traceability between requirements, configuration elements, and downstream testing artifacts


**Support for Testing \& Test Case Development**
* Assist in developing and refining test cases and scenarios based on configured system behavior
* Support test execution by validating configuration outcomes and ensuring expected system behavior
* Collaborate with testing teams to clarify expected results and assist with troubleshooting discrepancies


**Troubleshooting \& Defect Support During Testing**
* Investigate configuration\-related issues identified during system, integration, and user acceptance testing
* Support defect triage by analyzing system behavior, validating configuration settings, and identifying root causes
* Coordinate with integrators, developers, and SMEs to resolve issues and verify fixes


**Go\-Live \& Operational Readiness Support**
* Support system cutover, go\-live preparation, and stabilization activities
* Validate configuration completeness and readiness prior to production deployment
* Assist with post\-go\-live support activities, including troubleshooting and system adjustments


**Consulting Capability:**
* Ensures individual contributions are aligned with client needs and consistent with overall engagement objectives
* Understands and consistently meets client expectations within scope of engagement role by responding promptly and professionally to their inquiries
* Applies methods or recognized equivalent as appropriate to meet the specific needs of the client and engagement demands
* Conducts situation analysis through client interviews and documents research to determine the business strengths and weaknesses to identify preliminary engagement priorities
* May have matrix management responsibilities for resources on a project


**Scope:**
* Billable Hours target established in annual goal setting process. Generally works on 1\-4 concurrent projects at a given time.


**Management Responsibilities**
 Individual Contributor
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Information Technology or Engineering
* 5\+ years of experience in system configuration, application support, or technical implementation roles or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system configuration
* Experience with electric utility control systems operations or maintenance
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS or other OT platform projects through the complete lifecycle including requirements development, design, systems integration \& implementation and testing
* Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC, IEEE) and utility regulatory environments
* Experience supporting utility or critical infrastructure systems
* Familiarity with configuration workbooks, parameter management, or system setup in enterprise applications
* Exposure to testing processes (SIT, UAT) and defect management tools


**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, instrumentation or computer engineering, Information Systems, or similar Technical domain
* 3 years of experience in system configuration, application support, or technical implementation roles or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system configuration
* Exposure to software development or system delivery lifecycle (SDLC) including design, build, testing, and deployment
* Functional understanding of OT systems such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, or similar platforms
* Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into structured configuration outputs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Effective communication skills and ability to work in cross\-functional project teams
* Knowledge of Electric utilities operations functions and associated processes
* Actively participated in at least one ADMS or other OT platform projects with technical domain experience
* Hands\-on experience in utility OT platforms such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, DERMS, or related systems


**Minimum Qualifications**

 Information Technology

 Thane, Maharashtra

 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 4–5 years

 Work from Office
 



**Openings:** 
 1
 



 About Progenesis IVF
 



 Progenesis IVF is a growing healthcare organisation providing advanced fertility and reproductive healthcare services. Our technology and IT infrastructure play an important role in supporting our doctors, clinical teams, centres, and corporate operations.
 



 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on
 **Network Engineer** 
 to manage, maintain, troubleshoot, and secure our network infrastructure across the organisation.
 



 Job Summary
 



 The Network Engineer will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of network infrastructure, firewall administration, connectivity, troubleshooting, network security, and IT infrastructure support. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with
 **Sophos Firewall, LAN/WAN, VPN, TCP/IP, routing and switching** 
 , along with a
 **CCNA certification** 
 .
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage and maintain the organisation's LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and network infrastructure.
* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot
 **Sophos Firewall** 
 and related security policies.
* Manage firewall rules, NAT, VPNs, web filtering, application control, and network security configurations.
* Monitor network performance, availability, bandwidth, and connectivity.
* Troubleshoot network issues involving LAN, WAN, Internet, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and routing.
* Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers, access points, and other network devices.
* Handle user connectivity issues and provide timely technical support.
* Perform network installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Monitor network security and identify potential vulnerabilities or unauthorised access.
* Maintain network documentation, configurations, IP address records, and infrastructure diagrams.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and external vendors for connectivity and technical issues.
* Support IT infrastructure across corporate and branch/centre locations.
* Participate in network expansion, infrastructure improvement, and implementation projects.
* Ensure regular backup and documentation of network and firewall configurations.
* Follow IT security policies, access\-control procedures, and organisational standards.
* Maintain proper records of incidents, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 Experience
 


* **4–5 years of relevant experience** 
 in Network Engineering / Network Administration.
* Hands\-on experience managing enterprise network infrastructure.
* Strong practical experience with
 **Sophos Firewall** 
 .
* **CCNA certification is mandatory.**



 Technical Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of
 **TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, DNS, DHCP and VPN** 
 .
* Good understanding of routing and switching concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with routers, switches, access points, and network devices.
* Experience with firewall configuration, security policies, NAT, VPN, and web/application filtering.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of network monitoring and performance management.
* Understanding of network security and basic cybersecurity principles.
* Good knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, and routing protocols.
* Experience with Wi\-Fi/network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Windows\-based network environments is an advantage.



 Good to Have
 


* Experience working with
 **Sophos Central / Sophos Firewall** 
 .
* Knowledge of cybersecurity and endpoint security solutions.
* Experience managing networks across multiple branches or locations.
* Knowledge of AWS/Azure networking is an advantage.
* Experience in healthcare or multi\-location organisations will be an added advantage.
* Additional networking certifications such as CCNP will be a plus.



 Professional Skills
 


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities.
* Ability to handle multiple technical issues and prioritise tasks.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with the IT team.
* Willingness to travel to branch locations when required.
* Proactive approach towards network monitoring and problem resolution.



 Why Join Progenesis IVF?

title: Data Center & Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Alkem:**




  





 Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, that manufactures and sells pharmaceutical generics, formulations and nutraceuticals in India and globally over 50 countries. We have consistently been ranked amongst the top five pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan\-D, and Taxim\-O, which feature amongst the top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India.
 



  





**Purpose of the Role:**




  





 The incumbent will own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, and lifecycle management of Alkem's on\-premise infrastructure, enterprise networks, SD\-WAN, internet services, remote access, wireless networks, data centers, plant connectivity, and network security platforms.
 



 This role is responsible for ensuring a secure, scalable, resilient, and high\-performing network and infrastructure environment across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, R\&D centers, warehouses, distribution locations, and international operations, enabling seamless connectivity for users, applications, cloud platforms, and third\-party partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 1\. Enterprise Network Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise network architecture, standards, reference designs, IP addressing schemes, routing, segmentation, redundancy, and capacity plans.
* Lead engineering and implementation of LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, internet connectivity, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, load balancing, wireless networks, cloud connectivity, and remote access services.
* Conduct technical assessments and reviews for new facilities, plant expansions, data center upgrades, cloud integrations, application onboarding, and network modernization initiatives.
* Maintain current and future\-state architecture documentation, network diagrams, configuration standards, dependency maps, and technology roadmaps.



 2\. Network Operations \& Service Assurance
 


* Manage network availability, performance, utilization, configuration management, backup, patching, and lifecycle management of routers, switches, wireless controllers, access points, and related infrastructure.
* Implement and manage centralized network monitoring, configuration compliance, event management, traffic analytics, log collection, and proactive capacity monitoring.
* Lead resolution of critical incidents, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Define, monitor, and report network KPIs including availability, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization, incident response time, change success rate, and recurring fault trends.



 3\. Data Center \& On\-Premise Infrastructure Management
 


* Manage data center and server\-room infrastructure, including racks, power systems, UPS, structured cabling, environmental monitoring, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Coordinate operations of physical servers, virtualization platforms, storage systems, backup appliances, console access, and out\-of\-band management in collaboration with platform teams.
* Ensure resilient connectivity across primary and disaster recovery data centers, manufacturing plants, branch offices, cloud environments, and strategic partners.
* Support capacity planning, infrastructure refresh programs, relocations, consolidations, commissioning, and decommissioning activities while ensuring proper documentation and governance.



 4\. Network Security \& Segmentation
 


* Partner with Information Security teams to implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, SASE, Secure Web Access, Network Access Control (NAC), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), DNS security, and network segmentation controls.
* Maintain appropriate segregation between corporate IT, servers, guest networks, vendor access, laboratories, manufacturing systems, and OT environments based on approved security architecture.
* Manage and periodically review firewall rules, remote access paths, privileged administration access, third\-party connectivity, and network security exceptions.
* Ensure integration of network logs, alerts, and security events with enterprise monitoring and Security Operations processes.



 5\. Plant, OT \& Site Connectivity
 


* Ensure highly available communication services for manufacturing plants, laboratories, warehouses, utilities, serialization systems, automation platforms, and OT environments.
* Coordinate with Engineering, OT, Automation, Quality, Application, and Information Security teams to implement secure connectivity and manage controlled changes in regulated environments.
* Drive last\-mile redundancy, link diversity, failover testing, wireless coverage optimization, and site\-specific capacity planning initiatives.
* Maintain accurate inventories, network diagrams, telecom circuit records, support contacts, escalation matrices, and disaster recovery procedures for all sites.



 6\. Telecom, Carrier \& Vendor Management
 


* Manage relationships with telecom carriers, internet service providers, SD\-WAN partners, OEMs, system integrators, cabling vendors, and managed service providers.
* Oversee circuit procurement, service activation, bandwidth expansion, contract renewals, inventory reconciliation, billing validation, and service credit management.
* Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, incident response commitments, and improvement plans.
* Support vendor evaluation, technical scope definition, bill\-of\-material reviews, proof\-of\-concept activities, and technology selection initiatives.



 7\. Service Management, Governance \& Compliance
 


* Establish and enforce standard practices for solution deployment, hardening, change management, configuration management, backups, access controls, and documentation.
* Support audits, risk assessments, regulatory inspections, evidence collection, remediation planning, and compliance requirements relevant to pharmaceutical operations.
* Maintain infrastructure asset inventory, warranty and AMC records, software versions, licensing compliance, spares management, and end\-of\-life remediation plans.



  





**Educational Qualification:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.



  





**Professional Experience:**




  




* 8\-10 years of progressive experience in enterprise networking and on\-premise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in network architecture, engineering, infrastructure operations, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience managing large\-scale, multi\-site enterprise environments across corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and remote locations.



  





**Preferred Industry Experience:**




  




* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Chemical, Manufacturing, or other regulated industries is highly preferred.
* Proven exposure to supporting business\-critical applications, manufacturing operations, and geographically distributed users.



  





**Technical Competencies:**




  





 The incumbent should possess strong expertise in Routing \& Switching technologies, including TCP/IP, BGP, and OSPF protocols, along with comprehensive knowledge of LAN, WAN, and SD\-WAN environments. The role requires hands\-on experience in Wireless Networking, DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM), VPN technologies, Network Segmentation, Security Architecture, Network Monitoring, Performance Analysis, and advanced troubleshooting and incident management. The candidate should also have working knowledge of firewalls, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, cloud connectivity, Operational Technology (OT) networking, data center infrastructure, virtualization dependencies, ITIL\-based service management practices, vendor and contract management, as well as audit, compliance, and regulatory support activities.

 To own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, identity services, automation, resilience, and cost governance of Alkem’s hybrid infrastructure landscape, including Azure, AWS, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization platforms, data centres, storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments.
 



 The role is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective infrastructure and identity services across Alkem’s corporate offices, manufacturing locations, R\&D centres, data centres, and international operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 Hybrid Cloud Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, implement, and maintain reference architectures, standards, patterns, and governance frameworks for Azure, AWS, private cloud, and on\-premise infrastructure environments.
* Evaluate workload placement strategies based on business requirements, performance, security, compliance, recoverability, integration, data residency, and total cost of ownership.
* Conduct architecture reviews for new applications, cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
* Maintain architecture documentation, infrastructure standards, build specifications, configuration baselines, technical diagrams, and operational runbooks.



 Cloud Platform Operations \& Governance
 


* Manage cloud subscriptions, accounts, landing zones, management groups, resource hierarchies, tagging structures, policies, quotas, and shared services.
* Implement and govern controls for identity integration, privileged access, key and secret management, cloud connectivity, monitoring, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup, and patch management.
* Monitor cloud service health, capacity, availability, utilization, and performance metrics.
* Drive cloud governance, operational excellence, and FinOps initiatives to optimize infrastructure costs.



 Identity \& Access Infrastructure Management
 


* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise identity management platforms.
* Manage domain controllers, Active Directory forests, trusts, replication, DNS integration, Sites and Services, and Group Policy administration.
* Maintain hybrid identity services including Microsoft Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, federation services, and directory synchronization.
* Govern Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, and Conditional Access policies.
* Manage identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, deprovisioning, RBAC, service accounts, delegated administration, and privileged access controls.
* Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM), identity governance, access reviews, tiered administration, and privileged account protection.
* Ensure identity platform resilience through backup, disaster recovery, platform hardening, recovery testing, and replication monitoring.
* Support application integrations using LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and modern authentication protocols.
* Integrate identity logs, audit trails, authentication events, and threat intelligence with enterprise SIEM and SOC platforms.
* Drive identity modernization and Zero Trust initiatives in collaboration with Cybersecurity, HR, application, and business stakeholders.



 On\-Premise Infrastructure, Virtualization \& Storage
 


* Manage physical and virtual server infrastructure, operating systems, hypervisors, clusters, storage systems, converged infrastructure, and management platforms.
* Oversee provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, capacity management, lifecycle refresh, decommissioning, and compliance management.
* Support business\-critical infrastructure for SAP, manufacturing systems, databases, middleware, analytics platforms, and enterprise applications.



 Automation, Observability \& Resilience
 


* Drive automation initiatives using scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management tools, orchestration platforms, and reusable templates.
* Implement automated governance, compliance checks, and operational workflows.
* Establish centralized monitoring, observability, log management, dashboarding, event correlation, alerting, and service health reporting.
* Own enterprise backup, replication, recovery infrastructure, immutable repositories, cyber recovery, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Conduct restoration testing, disaster recovery drills, and business continuity exercises aligned with defined recovery objectives.



 Security \& Service Management
 


* Implement secure infrastructure baselines, encryption standards, privileged access controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and Zero Trust security practices.
* Ensure infrastructure and identity telemetry is integrated with enterprise monitoring and security operations platforms.
* Own ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, Capacity, and Availability Management.
* Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, preventive action planning, knowledge management, and runbook development.
* Manage infrastructure service providers and vendors against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, and performance metrics.



  





**Educational Qualifications:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, or identity certifications will be an added advantage.



  





**Experience:**




  




* 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud, hybrid infrastructure, or identity platform architecture and operations.
* Experience in managing Azure and/or AWS cloud environments, Active Directory, Hybrid AD, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery platforms.
* Experience supporting highly available enterprise applications and geographically distributed operations.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, chemical, manufacturing, or other regulated industries will be preferred.



  





**Technical Skills:**




  





 Strong expertise in Azure Cloud Services and AWS Cloud Services, with deep knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Proficient in managing Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Group Policy Administration, Conditional Access, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign\-On (SSO), Passwordless Authentication, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Governance \& Access Management. Hands\-on experience with Windows and Linux Server Administration, Virtualization Platforms, Storage Management, Backup and Disaster Recovery Solutions, and enterprise infrastructure operations. Strong capabilities in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Scripting and Automation, FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization, and Observability \& Monitoring Tools. Sound understanding of identity and authentication protocols including LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM, along with practical knowledge of ITIL Service Management Practices for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable IT services.

title: UAV Communication Engineer
description:
**Role Name : UAV Communication Engineer Robotics** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Manastu Space is a
 **Space Safety and Logistics company** 
 focused on making space
 **safe, sustainable, and accessible** 
 . We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
 **space debris mitigation and green propulsion** 
 , enabling safer satellite operations, and long\-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.
 



 Our work sits at the intersection of
 **advanced engineering, applied research, and mission\-critical systems** 
 , requiring deep technical capability and long\-term thinking.
 



**Website:** 
 https://www.manastuspace.com
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu\-space/
 



**Email:** 
 careers@manastuspace.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every drone we fly carries a flight controller (ArduPilot/PX4, MAVLink) and an embedded Linux companion computer (Rockchip RK3588 / Jetson class) with its own 4G/5G link. Today, our ground station handles one aircraft at a time — video and MAVLink telemetry/control work, but there is no owner and no architecture for running this across a fleet. Security and reliability gaps that don't show up at one drone will surface the moment we add more.
 



 You will own the system that moves two independent data streams — low\-latency video and bidirectional MAVLink telemetry/control — from all drones simultaneously to one dashboard, reliably, securely, and at fleet scale. This is a build\-and\-own role: you make the architecture decisions and defend them with measurements, write the pipelines, run the relay infrastructure, and carry a live fleet.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own the system that moves two independent data streams — low\-latency video and bidirectional MAVLink telemetry/control — from all drones simultaneously to one dashboard, reliably, securely, and at fleet scale.
* Make the architecture decisions and defend them with measurements.
* Write the pipelines, run the relay infrastructure, and carry a live fleet.
* Architecture for aggregating video \+ MAVLink telemetry from multiple aircraft onto one dashboard, scaling the system beyond today's single\-drone ceiling.
* Transport selection and defense — evaluating options against latency/bandwidth/reliability/cost budgets and documenting the call in writing (ADRs).
* Relay infrastructure: deploying and operating media server/SFU and MAVLink routing at fleet scale.
* Security and reliability by design: per\-device authentication, encrypted MAVLink, relay redundancy — built in from the start, not retrofitted.
* Rapid prototyping of unfamiliar transports or pipelines, measured and validated in days.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Experience: Minimum 3 years of working experience
 



 B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering
 



  





**Required Skills** 



* Broad working knowledge of the real\-time transport landscape — SRT, WebRTC, RTSP/RTP, RTMP, MQTT, VPN/overlay networks, raw UDP — with production depth in at least 2–3 of them.
* Proven architecture\-selection ability: can evaluate options against latency/bandwidth/reliability/cost budgets, choose, and defend the choice in writing (ADRs).
* Rapid prototyping habit: can build a working proof\-of\-concept of an unfamiliar transport or pipeline in days, measure it, and land a clear conclusion.
* Deep Linux networking: UDP/TCP internals, NAT/CGNAT traversal, VPNs; fluent with tcpdump/Wireshark.
* Experience transporting device telemetry or control data over unreliable networks (MQTT, raw UDP protocols, or similar) with delivery guarantees and per\-device authentication.
* Has deployed and operated server\-side media infrastructure: a media server or SFU (MediaMTX, SRS, Janus, LiveKit) or equivalent relay work.
* Codec literacy at the systems level: how GOP/keyframes/bitrate interact with transport and recovery (not encoder implementation).
* Python plus one of C\+\+/Go; server ops basics (VPS provisioning, TLS/certs, systemd).



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* MAVLink ecosystem: mavlink\-router, sysid\-based multi\-vehicle routing, MAVLink 2 signing.
* MQTT brokers in production: QoS levels, last\-will, per\-device credentials at fleet scale.
* coturn/TURN operations; WebRTC data channels.
* GStreamer/FFmpeg familiarity — enough to reproduce and debug streams end\-to\-end at the boundary with the embedded engineer.
* Has shipped video\-over\-cellular or teleoperation backend before (drone, bodycam, AV, broadcast contribution).
* VPN overlays in production: WireGuard, Tailscale/ZeroTier.
* Stream observability: latency/loss/jitter instrumentation, Grafana\-class monitoring.
* Cloud recording and object\-storage lifecycle design (S3/B2/R2\).



  





**Who Does Well Here** 



* Operates without support — builds from nothing, ships without a team behind them, owns mistakes.
* Defends technical decisions in writing and works the boundary with the embedded/firmware engineer and ops without friction.

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an IT System Administrator / Senior System Administrator , you'll be the backbone of CoinDCX's internal technology ecosystem, ensuring our employees have a secure, reliable, and seamless IT experience every day.
   

  

 This role goes beyond resolving technical issues—you'll help build scalable IT operations, strengthen endpoint security, streamline identity and access management, and continuously improve how technology enables our teams. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges while creating long\-term operational excellence, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of India's fastest\-growing fintech organizations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end endpoint support by troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, and network\-related issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
* Deliver exceptional L1 IT support by resolving user issues efficiently while ensuring an outstanding employee experience.
* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding by provisioning devices, accounts, application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.
* Administer Identity \& Access Management (IAM), MDM platforms, and SaaS applications to maintain secure and compliant user access.
* Drive incident, change, and asset management processes while maintaining accurate documentation, SOPs, and ticketing records.
* Monitor system health, analyze recurring issues, and implement permanent solutions that improve IT reliability and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with internal teams and L2/L3 support to resolve complex technical issues while ensuring timely communication with stakeholders.
* Support network infrastructure, wireless access points, antivirus solutions, and endpoint security initiatives to maintain a secure workplace.


**You'll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think proactively and focus on preventing issues rather than simply resolving them.
* Have a strong ownership mindset and consistently deliver reliable IT support.
* Enjoy troubleshooting complex technical problems across endpoints, operating systems, and networks.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Are process\-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Thrive in fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Continuously learn new technologies and look for opportunities to automate and improve IT operations.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Support, System Administration, or FinTech IT Operations.
* Strong expertise in Windows, macOS, hardware diagnostics, software troubleshooting, and endpoint management.
* Experience with Employee Onboarding \& Offboarding processes.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Experience managing Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
* Familiarity with SaaS administration including Active Directory, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and related collaboration tools.
* Working knowledge of ticketing platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, or ManageEngine ServiceDesk.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including LAN, VLAN, IP addressing, OSI model, and wireless access points.
* Knowledge of antivirus solutions, endpoint security, and IT compliance best practices.
* Experience with Incident Management, Change Management, and IT Asset Management.
* IT certifications such as ITIL, MCSA, or MCP will be an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel or relocate based on business requirements.


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
 Within your first six months:
   

  

* Employees experience fast, reliable, and high\-quality IT support with improved resolution times.
* Onboarding and offboarding processes are standardized, secure, and executed with zero operational gaps.
* Endpoint compliance, device management, and identity access processes are consistently maintained.
* Documentation, SOPs, and IT operational processes become more structured and scalable.
* Repeat incidents are reduced through proactive problem management and permanent fixes.
* Internal stakeholders trust the IT team as a reliable business partner.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 Technology is the foundation that enables every CoinDCX team to innovate at speed. In this role, you'll directly influence the productivity, security, and operational excellence of the organization.
   

  

 You'll work with modern IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystems, security tools, and enterprise technologies while gaining exposure to one of India's leading Web3 and fintech companies. As CoinDCX continues to scale, you'll have opportunities to grow your technical expertise, contribute to automation initiatives, and build systems that support the future of finance.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess your skills, experience, and alignment with the role.
* Recruiter Connect – A conversation to understand your background and career aspirations.
* Technical Interview(s) – Deep dive into your IT infrastructure knowledge, troubleshooting approach, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Practical Assessment / Scenario Discussion – Evaluate your ability to diagnose, prioritize, and resolve real\-world IT challenges.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – Understand how you collaborate, communicate, and thrive in fast\-paced environments.
* Leadership Conversation (Optional) – For select candidates, a discussion focused on long\-term growth and strategic alignment.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organization. This role is based out of our
 **Mumbai office** 
 , where innovation happens every day through close collaboration and shared ownership.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to support your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take the time you need to rest and recharge.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Regular learning opportunities to help you grow personally and professionally.


**Ready to Build What's Next?**
 If you're excited about creating reliable technology experiences, solving meaningful technical challenges, and enabling teams to do their best work, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us build the technology that powers the future of finance.

 PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
 



 OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
 



 Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
 



 Develop IO lists, control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS).
 



 Coordinate between MEP consultants, controls contractors, and operations to align automation design.
 



 Control System Development \- Must
 



 Author control sequence logic for:
 



 Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
 



  





 Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
 



 Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
 



 Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
 



 Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC\-UA, and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation
 



  





 Commissioning \& Validation
 



 Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
 



 Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
 



 Oversee integration testing with DCIM, AIops, or energy optimization platforms.
 



  





 OT \& Cybersecurity Governance
 



 Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
 



 Network segregation between IT and OT.
 



 Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
 



 Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
 



 Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
 



 Operations Enablement \- Must
 



 Create O\&M procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
 



 Change management and version control.
 



 Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
 



 Data historian configuration and retention policies.
 



 Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
 



 Maintain system access logs, firmware inventories, and security posture reports
 



 Continuous Optimization \- Must
 



 Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
 



 Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
 



 Integrate AI models for predictive control.
 



 Support digital twin deployment and data validation
 



  





 Contract and Stakeholder Management
 



 Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
 



 Negotiate contracts and oversee service\-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high standards of performance.
 



  





 At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Low Latency Network Engineer (Trading Infrastructure)
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Type:** 
 Permanent
 



**Experience:** 
 10 plus years in network/infrastructure engineering (trading/HFT experience strongly preferred)
 



  





 Design, build and support the high\-performance network that powers a proprietary trading firm's global strategy. You'll work on ultra\-low\-latency LAN/WAN, multicast market\-data distribution and exchange connectivity across colocation data centres, with a heavy focus on performance, resilience and automation. This role sits at the core of the trading platform—close to traders, developers and infrastructure teams—where microsecond\-level improvements matter.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Design, implement and maintain low\-latency network infrastructure for trading applications (Arista/Cisco, leaf–spine, bare\-metal servers).
* Configure and tune Layer 2/3 protocols: BGP, OSPF, VRF, PIM/IGMP, multicast, QoS, STP, NAT.
* Support exchange connectivity, cross\-connects and colocation deployments; work with carriers and data\-centre teams.
* Troubleshoot latency, jitter, packet loss and microbursts using tcpdump, Wireshark, NIC stats and switch telemetry.
* Automate network changes and validations using Python, Bash and/or Ansible; contribute to IaC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor network health and performance; create dashboards and alerts for proactive incident management.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Telecommunications or related field.
* 10 plus years of hands\-on networking experience, ideally in HFT, prop trading, exchanges or other latency\-sensitive environments.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, multicast, routing (BGP/OSPF), switching, VLANs and data\-centre networking.
* Practical experience with Arista and/or Cisco NX\-OS in production trading or financial\-services environments.
* Strong Linux networking fundamentals; comfortable working in a terminal and with performance tooling.
* Proven troubleshooting skills for low\-latency issues (packet captures, NIC/driver tuning, switch buffers, PTP/NTP).

title: Solutions Architect - IIOT
description:
About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for an experienced IoT Solutions Architect with strong hands\-on background in Industrial IoT (IIoT) to design, architect, and lead end\-to\-end implementation of IoT solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other industrial environments. This role requires someone who has not just designed architectures on paper but has actually built, deployed, and supported IIoT solutions in real production/plant environments.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  





 •       Design end\-to\-end IoT/IIoT architecture — from edge devices, sensors, and gateways to cloud platforms, data pipelines, and analytics/visualization layers.
 



 •       Lead technical implementation of IIoT projects including device connectivity (OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, LoRaWAN), edge computing, and integration with SCADA/PLC/DCS/MES systems.
 



 •       Define data ingestion, storage, and processing architecture (time\-series DBs, stream processing, digital twin frameworks).
 



 •       Select and integrate appropriate IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, etc.) based on client/business needs.
 



 •       Own solution architecture from PoC to production rollout, including scalability, security, and reliability considerations.
 



 •       Collaborate with OT/IT teams to bridge industrial systems with enterprise IT and cloud infrastructure.
 



 •       Define and implement IoT security architecture — device authentication, data encryption, network segmentation (IT/OT security).
 



 •       Create technical documentation: architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, deployment guides, and SOPs.
 



 •       Work closely with sales/pre\-sales teams for solutioning, technical proposals, and client presentations.
 



 •       Design and deploy LoRaWAN\-based sensor networks, including gateway placement, network server configuration, and device provisioning.
 



 •       Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues during deployment and post\-production support.
 



  




 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  





 •       4–5 years in IoT/embedded systems/industrial automation, with hands\-on experience in IIoT solution architecture and implementation.
 



 •       Proven experience implementing (not just designing) IIoT solutions — device onboarding, edge deployment, cloud integration, dashboarding.
 



 •       Strong knowledge of industrial protocols: OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, BACnet, etc.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with LoRaWAN technologies — network architecture, gateway/end\-node deployment, network server platforms (e.g., The Things Stack, ChirpStack), and LoRaWAN device integration.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with one or more IoT/cloud platforms: AWS IoT Core/Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub/Edge, GCP Cloud IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, Litmus, or similar.
 



 •       Experience with edge computing devices/gateways (e.g., Dell Edge Gateways, Advantech, Siemens IoT2050, Raspberry Pi/industrial variants).
 



 •       Understanding of SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and OT network architecture.
 



 •       Experience with time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and data visualization tools (Grafana, Power BI).
 



 •       Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for edge/cloud deployments.
 



 •       Familiarity with IoT security best practices (device identity, PKI, network segmentation).
 



 •       Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Node.js, or similar) for automation and integration work.
 



 •       Experience working directly at customer/plant sites for deployment, commissioning, and troubleshooting is a strong plus.
 



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 
 •       Certifications such as AWS/Azure IoT specialty, CSSA, or relevant OT security certifications.
 



 •       Experience with digital twin implementations.
 



 •       Exposure to predictive maintenance / condition monitoring use cases.
 



 •       Prior experience in manufacturing, energy, utilities, or process industries.
 



  




 Education
 * •       B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related field (M.Tech/MS preferred but not mandatory).

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Individual Contributor)
description:
TRYST is a research\-to\-translation institution on the IIT Bombay campus, working across semiconductors, AI, health and bio, energy and clean technology, and related verticals. It is building the digital and IT environment for a multi\-Centre organisation that is expected to scale toward 1,000\+ people, while remaining on campus and partnering with IIT Bombay shared services.
 



 This is a founding IT role: the opportunity to design and run the function, not to inherit one.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations** 



* Operate Microsoft 365 / Entra ID as TRYST’s directory: account hygiene, groups, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and the joiner / mover / leaver path from the HR system (Keka).
* Own endpoint management and protection (Intune or equivalent, disk encryption, patching and baseline hardening). TRYST handles research IP; unmanaged devices are not the default.
* Own infrastructure security for TRYST\-run systems: access, backups, incident first\-response, and the first set of IT security policies with the CEO.
* Keep security usable. Default access should follow the employee’s role; exceptions should be the minority.



**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.
* Support lab, compute and connectivity needs of research Centres, escalating specialised research computing to Computing Centre or an agreed cloud pattern.



**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.
* Maintain the IT asset register and lifecycle — issue, recover, wipe and recycle — tied to joining and leaving.
* Manage the infrastructure and endpoint budget and provide actuals for TRYST IT cost planning.



**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.



**REMUNERATION** 




**Level** 




 Manager.
 



**Compensation** 




 Competitive and commensurate with experience

* Strong troubleshooting instinct and pattern recognition.

title: IT Manager
description:
IT Manager \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Own the systems a real assets platform runs on — the accounting and business applications, the devices, the network, the security — and implement the ones it does not have yet. One IT manager commanding vendors, not running a department.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Chief Financial Officer · until that seat is filled, the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts · EXPERIENCE: 8–12 years in IT and business\-systems management, including at least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation you ran
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE OPERATING LAYER HAS AN OWNER
 



 Vantrock runs on its dashboards. Models, trackers, the close calendar, the Asset Review pack, the matter tracker — all of it lives on the platform's operating layer, and the platform's own intelligence arm builds the tools that sit on top. But somebody has to own the layer underneath: the accounting and business applications and their implementation; the devices every person works on; the network in the office and at every site; the identities, access and security that keep a finance function's data where it belongs; the licences, the vendors and the budget.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 A finance function of twenty\-one seats keeping its books in\-house needs an accounting system implemented properly, integrated with the platform's dashboards, secured, backed up and supported — before the first month\-end runs on it. A platform with sites to open in four cities needs each one connected and equipped on the day it does. And a company built to run on technology needs someone whose job is that the technology runs. None of that exists yet as a function. This seat is it.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The accounting and business systems. The finance function's system of record — selected with the Chief Financial Officer and the General Manager, implemented on a plan you run, integrated with the platform's operating layer, and supported after go\-live.
 



 2\. Implementations. Every system the platform adopts taken from decision to daily use: requirements with the function head, vendor selection, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cut\-over, hyper\-care.
 



 3\. Devices, network and sites. Every person equipped and connected; the office and every project site on a network that works; new sites live on the day they open.
 



 4\. Identity, access and security. Who can see what, enforced in the systems, not in a policy document.
 



 5\. Vendors and licences. The IT vendors, the software licences, the support contracts — scoped, negotiated, held to their service levels, and inside the budget you own.
 



 6\. Support. The first call when something does not work, and a standard for how fast it is fixed — with the platform's intelligence arm as your partner for anything that touches the product layer.
 



 7\. The technology roadmap. A written, budgeted view of what the platform will need in twelve and twenty\-four months, refreshed each quarter with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 8–12 years in IT management and business systems, of which a meaningful part at a mid\-sized company where you were the IT function, not a member of one.
 



 – At least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation run end to end by you — requirements to hyper\-care — for a finance team that then used it. This will be discussed in detail.
 



 – Devices, networks, identity and access, and information security managed for a distributed business — more than one office or site.
 



 – Vendor and licence management as the client: scoping, negotiating, service levels, budget.
 



 – Comfortable with a finance function's requirements — you can talk to a controller about a chart of accounts and to a payables head about approval workflows.
 



 – Hands\-on when needed, and honest about what you do not know.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not a software\-development seat. The platform's product and AI tools are built by its intelligence arm; this seat runs the layer they sit on.
 



 – Not a helpdesk seat. Support is part of the job; the implementations and the security are the job.
 



 – Not a large\-team management seat. You command vendors; you do not manage a department.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – Outsource the doing, own the outcome. Vendors implement and support; you command them and are accountable for the result.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. The asset register, the licence log, the ticket queue and the roadmap live on the operating layer.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every implementation has a plan and a sign\-off; every access change has a record; every incident has a cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with travel to sites.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Implementation conversation. The ERP or accounting system you implemented: the plan, what went wrong at cut\-over, what the finance team said six months later. With the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts, or the Chief Financial Officer once in seat.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A brief for a finance function of twenty seats going live on a new accounting system in ninety days, across a head office and two sites — from which you produce the implementation plan, the access model and the three risks that would derail it. Reviewed with the General Manager and the Founder \& CEO.
 



 3\. References. Two, contacted directly: one former reporting manager and one finance\-function user of a system you implemented.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "IT Manager — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – Your Systems Sheet — one row per system you implemented or ran: system, function served, users, your role, year, outcome. The template is available on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the mistake most companies make in the first thirty days of an accounting\-system implementation, and how you would stop this one making it. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a Systems Sheet and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock
