title: Passive Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description** 
 – Passive Network Engineer
 



  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 5–10 Years Preferred
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Passive Network Engineer to join our team in Mumbai. The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in structured cabling, fibre optic networks, and passive network infrastructure, preferably with exposure to data centres, commercial buildings, and large\-scale ICT projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Installation and implementation of structured cabling systems, including Copper and Fibre Optic cabling.
 



 • Cable pulling, dressing, routing, and proper cable management as per approved layouts and industry standards.
 



 • Termination of Cat 6, Cat 6A, and other copper cabling systems on patch panels, information outlets, and related components.
 



 • Fibre optic cable termination, jointing, and fusion splicing.
 



 • Installation and termination of LIUs, fibre patch panels, ODFs, racks, and related passive components.
 



 • Testing and certification of copper and fibre networks using appropriate testing equipment.
 



 • Perform fibre testing using OTDR, Optical Power Meter, Light Source, and other fibre testing instruments.
 



 • Perform copper cable certification using Fluke or equivalent cable certification equipment.
 



 • Troubleshooting and rectification of fibre and copper connectivity issues.
 



 • Installation and management of patch cords, fibre jumpers, and rack\-level connectivity.
 



 • Coordination with project managers, vendors, OEMs, contractors, and customer teams during project execution.
 



 • Supervision of technicians and installation teams at project sites.
 



 • Ensure installations are carried out as per approved drawings, BOQ, method statements, and OEM standards.
 



 • Preparation and maintenance of testing reports, cable schedules, labelling records, redline drawings, and project documentation.
 



 • Ensure adherence to safety standards, site procedures, and quality requirements.
 



 • Support site surveys, material planning, measurements, and project handover activities.
 



  





**Required Skills:** 




 • Strong knowledge of Structured Cabling Systems.
 



 • Hands\-on experience in Cable Pulling, Cable Dressing, and Cable Management.
 



 • Copper Cable Termination.
 



 • Fibre Optic Cable Termination.
 



 • Fusion Splicing.
 



 • Fibre and Copper Testing \& Certification.
 



 • OTDR Testing.
 



 • Fluke Testing / Certification.
 



 • Installation of LIUs, Patch Panels, ODFs, and Racks.
 



 • Rack Dressing and Patch Cord Management.
 



 • Understanding of Single Mode and Multimode Fibre.
 



 • Understanding of Cat 6 / Cat 6A cabling systems.
 



 • Ability to read network layouts, cable schedules, drawings, and BOQs.
 



 • Good troubleshooting and site coordination skills.
 



 • Ability to manage technicians and installation teams.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 • 5–10 years of relevant experience in passive networking / structured cabling projects.
 



 • Experience working on Data Centre and Enterprise ICT projects will be preferred.
 



 • CommScope Certification preferred.
 



 • Certifications from other recognised structured cabling OEMs will be an added advantage.
 



 • Familiarity with industry standards and structured cabling best practices.
 



  





**Candidate Profile:** 




 The ideal candidate should be technically strong, hands\-on, and capable of independently managing passive networking activities at site. The individual should have good coordination skills and be comfortable working in demanding project environments while maintaining high standards of installation quality, testing, and documentation.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager with strong hands\-on experience in Network Security, Firewall technologies, and team leadership. The ideal candidate will be an individual contributor as well as a team manager, capable of driving complex projects while also mentoring and managing a team of Network Security Engineers and Consultants.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end network security projects across global enterprise environments.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert on Palo Alto Networks, FortiGate, Cisco Firewalls, and Load Balancers (Citrix/F5\).
* Design, implement, and manage security rules and configurations on Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls.
* Troubleshoot Layer 4 and Layer 7 application and connectivity issues.
* Oversee Global Protect VPN configurations and support.
* Manage firewall backups and recovery operations for business continuity.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables aligned with PMP and ITIL frameworks.
* Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for configuration changes and operational processes.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network security engineers and consultants, ensuring high\-quality project delivery.
* Interface with clients, vendors, and internal teams to present project status, security recommendations, and risk assessments.
* Lead and mentor a team of network security engineers and consultants.
* Allocate tasks, review configurations, and guide the team to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct training and upskilling sessions for team members on security best practices and tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across network security operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s or Master's in one of: Computer Science or Related filed.
* 8\+ years of overall experience in Network Security and Project Management.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Palo Alto or FortiGate firewalls and Load Balancers (F5/Citrix).
* In\-depth understanding of Network Security, Firewalls, VPN, and advanced troubleshooting at L4\-L7\.
* Proven experience managing global security infrastructure projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of ITIL processes, change management, and incident/problem management.
* Experience in creating security rules, policy updates, and access control configurations.
* PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)
* PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer)
* NSE4 (Fortinet Network Security Expert Level 4\)
* Citrix (Networking / ADC)


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
